note: Every fact below was checked against its source on the collection date. Contacts are official public company contacts, not personal data.

signals.what_happened: Kolkata plastic packaging maker with a Howrah facility raised Rs 56.12 crore in an SME IPO (bidding 11-16 Sep 2026). Proceeds fund a Phase IV expansion of 4,800 MT a year, taking capacity to 18,070 MT.
signals.why_it_matters: Lakhotia's website names plastics and packaging as the highest-demand segment in the Howrah belt. A company that just raised money to grow capacity may need more land.
signals.check_before_contact: Where Phase IV will be built (see the prospectus).
signals.first_message: Hi {first_name}, congratulations on the IPO. I read that Phase IV adds 4,800 MT a year. If you're still deciding where that capacity goes, Lakhotia Industrial Complex in Howrah has freehold plots from 1 acre. Happy to share the layout.

signals.contact_name: Contact to identify (MD or head of operations)
signals.what_happened: Kolkata maker of automated car parking systems (part of Sotefin SA, Switzerland). SME IPO of Rs 89.76 crore, open 16-20 July 2026. Stated use of funds includes setting up a manufacturing facility in Kolkata, West Bengal.
signals.why_it_matters: They said in public that they are building a factory. Engineering units fit Lakhotia's 1-3 acre plots. If land is not fixed yet, this is the moment.
signals.check_before_contact: Whether land for the facility is already bought (see the prospectus).
signals.first_message: Hi {first_name}, saw that Sotefin Bharat plans a new manufacturing facility in Kolkata after the IPO. If the site isn't final yet, Lakhotia Industrial Complex on Ranihati–Amta Road has freehold plots and helps with approvals. Worth a quick look?

signals.what_happened: Foundation stone laid 11 July 2026 for a Rs 600 crore expansion at Dankuni, Hooghly: 12 lakh sq ft added, 20 lakh sq ft total. Expected 3,000 direct and 6,000 indirect jobs.
signals.why_it_matters: Staff moving for this plant will need homes. Shree Heights is in Chandannagar, the same district. One tie-up with HR can reach many buyers at once.
signals.check_before_contact: When the plant opens and how many staff will relocate.
signals.first_message: Hi {first_name}, read about the Dankuni expansion and the 3,000 new jobs. Shree Heights in Chandannagar has 2 and 3BHK homes that are almost ready. Would a home-buying offer for your Hooghly team be useful? Happy to set it up.

signals.contact_name: Contact to identify (staff welfare or administration)
signals.what_happened: AIIMS Kalyani notified 34 faculty posts (10 Professor, 4 Additional Professor, 1 Associate Professor, 19 Assistant Professor). Applications closed 26 July 2026.
signals.why_it_matters: New senior doctors join over the coming months, many from other cities. Vrindavan Greens' website lists AIIMS Kalyani as 15 minutes away.
signals.check_before_contact: Reach individual doctors on LinkedIn only after they have joined. Ask administration about a housing notice board.
signals.first_message: Hi Dr {last_name}, congratulations on joining AIIMS Kalyani. If you're looking for a home nearby, Vrindavan Greens is a gated plotted community 15 minutes away at Madanpur. You buy the land and build your own house. Can I send the plot map?

signals.what_happened: Beverage plant expansion in Taratala, Kolkata. Rs 64.16 crore. Bottled water, juice and canned soft drinks.
signals.why_it_matters: A growing drinks plant inside the city runs out of room for storage and dispatch.
signals.check_before_contact: Company name is hidden on the free tracker page. Find it in pollution board or environmental clearance records.

signals.what_happened: State-run industrial park in Uluberia, Howrah, on NH-6. WBIDC has possession of 128.69 acres.
signals.why_it_matters: Same district and highway. Lakhotia should lead with freehold ownership, free plot advice and approvals help.

signals.what_happened: New MSME industrial park and warehouse on 8.76 acres in Howrah, Rs 14.63 crore. Developer name hidden.
signals.why_it_matters: Smaller park competing for the same SME buyers.
